doc: Initializes two adjacent sub-structures inside the object pointed to by arg0: sets/ORs flag bytes at offsets 0x0/0x1, copies three global words (D_80071678/D_80071680/D_8007167C) into offsets 0x8/0x4/0xC, then bumps to arg0+0x18 and does the same for a second smaller header (flag byte, two u16 fields), returning a pointer to (arg0+0x18+0xC).

globals.name: D_80071678
globals.decl: single s32 word, hi/lo addressed (not gp_rel) — declare as struct { s32 v; s32 pad[2]; } so size>8 forces %hi/%lo codegen; only .v is read

globals.name: D_8007167C
globals.decl: same shape as D_80071678; only .v read

globals.name: D_80071680
globals.decl: same shape as D_80071678; only .v read
